transcript.text: Hello, this is Mumbai Bank calling regarding your overdue credit card payment. I’d like to remind you that your outstanding balance is pending, and a late fee of ₹1500 has been applied. Can you please let me know when you’ll be able to clear this amount? Please note, non-payment can severely impact your credit score and may lead to legal action. If you’re facing any difficulty, I’m here to help and can even offer some discounts if needed. When can we expect your payment?
I already paid that two days ago through UPI. So I don't understand why you're calling about an overdue payment.

Thank you for letting me know. Sometimes payment updates can take a little time to reflect in our system. Could you please confirm the amount you paid and the transaction date? If possible, do you have a transaction reference number as well? This will help me update your account and resolve the issue quickly.

I apologize for any inconvenience. Your credit record is important, so I’ll make sure this is sorted.
I paid the full amount, ₹25,000, on the 20th of June via UPI. I don’t have the reference number on me right now, but it was definitely done then.
